reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ashley Velazquez
reviewSamples.text: Southern Roots did a great job on our oak! They came out the same day for a free estimate and had our tree trimmed 2 days later. They supported law enforcement, were friendly, and communicated well. I’ve included before and after pictures. Now we are ready for hurricane season.
